verdict.rationale: Azure documents an official REST API reference that covers using curl in scripts, registering a client with Microsoft Entra ID to authenticate requests, and client libraries for most services. That gives a basis for runnable examples, but nothing shows an interactive explorer or in-browser execution, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on all candidate paths. Missing for 10: an interactive explorer (e.g. a 'Try it' console), runnable examples embedded in the reference, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec at a discoverable path, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
